columns.intraday_volume_shortfall_ratio: float: (official regular - stored 5m) / official regular when short by whole lots; 0 when EXACT/WITHIN_ONE_LOT; NaN unknown
columns.intraday_volume_overcount: float shares: stored 5m - official regular when positive; 0 otherwise; NaN unknown
columns.exclusion_reason: first failing rule for the price backtest; empty when usable

NO_TRADE_INTERVAL_ACCEPTED_FOR_RESEARCH.indicator_input: volume=0 and a flagged research-derived price; conditional, not per-bar proof
NO_TRADE_INTERVAL_ACCEPTED_FOR_RESEARCH.source: missing bar on a VERIFIED_CANDIDATE_ACCEPTED_FOR_RESEARCH symbol-day

EXECUTABLE_SLOT.definition: REAL_BAR with volume > 0 on a can_use_for_price_backtest symbol-day

timing.bar_available_at: bar_start + 5 minutes; 13:30 closing-call bar after the 13:30 match
timing.resampled_bar_available_at: bucket_end = end of the last EXPECTED 5m slot of the bucket (never the last real bar, bar_end); CLOSE_AUCTION separate, after the 13:30 match; see docs/RESEARCH_REPO_INTERFACE.md section 2.2
timing.same_day_mask_use: post-hoc data-availability exclusion only (Level B is a post-hoc mask); never universe selection, ranking or signal input; report INVALIDATED trades
timing.fill: next EXECUTABLE_SLOT open + slippage + fees + tax; never the signal bar's own close

applies_to.note: v1.1.0 changes wording/semantics only for the formal 1.0.0 mask; see errata_v1_0_0

VERIFIED_CANDIDATE_ACCEPTED_FOR_RESEARCH.meaning: conditional research acceptance of a symbol-day: VERIFIED = the exchange-date and rule evidence were accepted; CANDIDATE = the missing bars are not proven trade-free one by one

CANDIDATE_NO_BOARD_LOT_TRADE.meaning: volume bound only; range not corroborated

DAY_LEVEL_MISSING_VOLUME.meaning: whole-lot shortfall on a reference-complete date; slot unknown

DAY_LEVEL_MISSING_VOLUME_REFETCH_CONSIST.meaning: as DAY_LEVEL but the fixed-price reference was only re-fetched consistently (quality >= 1.1.0)

REFETCH_CONSISTENT.meaning: re-request returned HTTP 200 with identical values; shows reproducibility, not completeness

REFERENCE_COMPLETE.meaning: report proven complete by an independent source or official notice; value COMPLETE in reference_completeness

slot_types_reserved.NO_TRADE_INTERVAL_EVIDENCED: reserved for per-bar evidence (e.g. official tick or 5m data); no current status maps to it

level_B.multi_day_holding: not formal until B3 corporate actions, B4 price limits / tick sizes, B5 universe completeness are resolved

invalidated_trades.definition: trade a strategy would have taken on a symbol-day excluded by the same-day mask
report: sensitivity: results with INVALIDATED trades excluded vs filled by a conservative proxy

volume_tolerance_exploratory.definition: derived by the research repo: status in {EXACT, WITHIN_ONE_LOT, SHORTFALL_WHOLE_LOTS} and intraday_volume_shortfall_ratio <= 0.005
volume_tolerance_exploratory.use: exploration flag and sensitivity analysis only

official_daily.known_at: trade date after official publication (contract assumes 20:00 Asia/Taipei)
official_daily.intraday_fill: never; RANGE_ONLY symbol-days are not used for formal intraday fills

quarantine_frozen_v1.policy: frozen; whole exchange-date excluded; un-quarantine of any symbol or date only in a new version with independent evidence and a separate sign-off; never edited in place

items: missing 1-lot trade offset by a 1-lot double count in another bar: r=0, high/low unchanged
missing 1-lot trade offset by a component overstated by 1 lot: r=0
hidden trade priced inside the stored high/low passes the range gate
first bar / 13:30 closing call: caught only when open/close price differs
adjacent-day attribution: a moved lot can cancel a missing lot on the next day
disposal sessions and non-standard units are excluded, not evaluated
negative residuals cluster on few exchange-dates: no binomial / rule-of-three bound

errata_v1_0_0.reference_completeness: in the formal 1.0.0 mask, value COMPLETE on TWSE 2024-02-05, 2025-04-07, 2025-04-10 means REFETCH_CONSISTENT (from reference_completeness_cleared.csv 'cleared'), not REFERENCE_COMPLETE
errata_v1_0_0.gap_evidence_status: DAY_LEVEL_MISSING_VOLUME on those three dates reads as DAY_LEVEL_MISSING_VOLUME_REFETCH_CONSISTENT_ONLY
errata_v1_0_0.acceptance_rule_v2_json: P1 'independent source' and P3 'rule-of-three 95 % upper bound' are withdrawn; see acceptance_premises in quality >= 1.1.0
